title: Summarize Valid Category Amounts
summary: Build aggregate mapping state from validated records.

contract.input: A collection of arbitrary category:amount text records.
contract.output: A category-to-total mapping built from valid records.

examples.input: records mix repeated valid categories and invalid data
examples.explanation: Valid food amounts accumulate to seventeen.

blocks.content: Each record should contain exactly one colon separating a non-empty trimmed category and digits-only non-negative whole-number amount. Ignore invalid records. Return a mapping from each valid category to the sum of its amounts.
